title: zi-ai-event-stream: streaming primitive
description: Port utils/event-stream.ts to zig. Generic EventStream(T, R) with push/end/result + AssistantMessageEventStream specialization. Async iteration pattern in zig (likely channel-based or callback-based). Depends on types only.

title: zi-ai-stream: top-level entry points
description: Port stream.ts to zig. stream/complete/streamSimple/completeSimple — thin wrappers that resolve provider from api-registry and delegate. Depends on types, event-stream, api-registry.

title: zi-ai-types: core types
description: Port types.ts to zig. All core structs/enums/tagged unions: Message (User/Assistant/ToolResult), Content (Text/Thinking/Image/ToolCall), Model, Context, Tool, Usage, StreamOptions, StopReason, AssistantMessageEvent (12-variant tagged union), Api, Provider, ThinkingLevel. Pure data, zero deps. Foundation for everything.

title: zi-ai-provider-remaining: mistral + bedrock
description: Port providers/mistral.ts (585 lines) + amazon-bedrock.ts (807 lines). Mistral uses conversations API. Bedrock uses AWS SDK converse-stream. These complete the provider set.

title: zi-ai-faux: in-memory test provider
description: Port pi-mono's faux.ts as an in-memory test provider. Uses the stream engine to produce events from canned AssistantMessage responses. Validates the full stack: faux provider → registry → stream → events. Conformance tests from faux-provider.test.ts: usage estimation (line 196), response queuing (line 117), exhausted responses (line 132), text+thinking+toolcall streaming (line 329).

title: zi-ai-provider-openai-responses: openai responses API provider
description: Port providers/openai-responses.ts (251 lines) + openai-responses-shared.ts (513 lines) + openai-codex-responses.ts (929 lines) + azure-openai-responses.ts (248 lines). Responses API is newer OpenAI streaming format. Shared logic between standard, codex, and azure variants.

title: zi-ai-provider-anthropic: first provider
description: Port providers/anthropic.ts (906 lines) to zig. HTTP client + SSE parsing + Anthropic message format transform. Includes cache control, stealth mode headers, tool schema conversion, streaming event mapping. Depends on types, event-stream, utils, models. First provider validates the full provider pattern.

title: zi-ai-oauth: provider OAuth flows (defer)
description: Port utils/oauth/ (7 files). Provider-specific OAuth: anthropic, github-copilot, google-antigravity, google-gemini-cli, openai-codex, PKCE helpers, types. Can defer — not needed for API key usage. Only needed for browser/interactive auth flows.

title: zi-ai-api-registry: provider dispatch
description: Port api-registry.ts to zig. registerApiProvider/getApiProvider/unregisterApiProviders/clearApiProviders. Maps Api enum → {stream, streamSimple} function pointers. Depends on types + event-stream.

title: zi-phase0-contracts: define layer boundaries as zig types
description: Define public contracts for all layers. No implementation — just types, interfaces, and build.zig module DAG. Must compile. packages/ai/protocol.zig already exists (L1+L2 types). Add: ai/provider.zig (Provider vtable + Registry), agent/protocol.zig (AgentMessage, AgentTool, AgentState, AgentEvent, AgentContext), agent/hooks.zig (AgentLoopConfig hook bag). Restructure build.zig for multi-package (ai + agent modules with dependency edges).

title: zi-ai-provider-google: google providers
description: Port providers/google.ts (476 lines) + google-vertex.ts (542 lines) + google-gemini-cli.ts (987 lines) + google-shared.ts (326 lines). Three google variants sharing common logic. Gemini CLI is the largest single provider file.

title: zi-ai-provider: vtable provider interface + api registry
description: Provider vtable interface (nullclaw pattern) + ApiRegistry (pi-mono's api-registry.ts). Provider has stream/streamSimple via vtable dispatch. Registry maps Api → Provider. Test cases: register/unregister (faux-provider.test.ts line 588), lookup, clear.

title: zi-ai-stream: pull-iterator event stream engine
description: Port the streaming event protocol from pi-mono's faux.ts streamWithDeltas(). Pull-iterator design: caller calls next() which returns the next AssistantMessageEvent or null when done. Implements the exact event ordering contract: start → (thinking_start/delta/end | text_start/delta/end | toolcall_start/delta/end)* → done|error. Test cases from faux-provider.test.ts: exact event order (line 364), all block types (line 329), error/aborted terminals (line 413/438), multiple tool calls (line 392).

title: zi-phase1-vertical: zi -p "hello" end-to-end
description: The simplest working thing. Parse -p flag, single-turn agent loop (no tools), anthropic provider (HTTP POST + SSE), print text_deltas to stdout. Forces every layer thin but real. Validates types serialize correctly, streaming works, event protocol is right, layer boundaries are real. Depends on phase0 contracts being done.

title: zi-ai-provider-openai: openai-completions provider
description: Port providers/openai-completions.ts (871 lines) + transform-messages.ts (172 lines) + simple-options.ts (46 lines) to zig. Covers openai, xai, groq, cerebras, openrouter, zai, huggingface via compat flags. HTTP client + SSE + extensive compat handling.

title: zi-ai-models: model registry + codegen
description: Port models.ts to zig: getModel/getModels/getProviders/calculateCost/supportsXhigh/modelsAreEqual. Model definitions become comptime-embedded data. Includes bun/typescript codegen script (scripts/generate-models.ts) that fetches from models.dev + openrouter + vercel ai gateway APIs and writes models_generated.zig. Depends on types.

title: zi-ai-env-keys: environment API key resolution
description: Port env-api-keys.ts to zig. Maps provider name → environment variable lookup (OPENAI_API_KEY, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, etc). Special handling for vertex ADC credentials, bedrock multi-source auth, copilot tokens. Depends on types only.

title: zi-ai-register-builtins: provider wiring + lazy loading
description: Port providers/register-builtins.ts (433 lines) + faux.ts (498 lines). Wire all providers into registry. In zig this becomes comptime dispatch or explicit init. Faux provider is for testing. Includes forwardStream bridge pattern.

title: zi-ai-utils: pure utility functions
description: Port utils/ to zig: overflow.zig (context overflow detection via regex patterns), json_parse.zig (streaming partial JSON parser), hash.zig (fast deterministic hash), sanitize_unicode.zig (unpaired surrogate removal), validation.zig (tool argument validation against JSON schema). Pure functions depending on types only.
